column1: # Fill `register` and `grade` per line DURING the session, cold by feel, as each
# amy-voiced line finishes. Copy this file to `grades.tsv` for a real run.
#       admitted = cleared the delivery gate; you can say exactly why it landed (tops at "understood")
#       felt     = surprise + loss of words for why; a different system came online; may move Safety state
#       none     = ran straight through; failed the gate
#   grade    : F D C B A S  (optional trailing + / -, e.g. A+, S-)  — the cold felt grade
#   note     : optional free text (what landed, what slid the lens off, body read)
# Columns are tab-separated. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# label is orientation only — `exp4-score` joins on line_id via the run manifest.
